groups.part: Part 5 · Grace and the Night Sky

questions.q: Why did Grace borrow books from the library?

choices.A: To learn the names of things in the sky
choices.B: To find a new science club
choices.C: To read stories about her grandfather

questions.q: What does Grace hope to become?

groups.passage:
When Grace was ten, she became interested in the stars. Her grandfather gave her a small telescope for her birthday. Every clear evening, she took it into the backyard to look at the moon and bright planets.
At first, she did not know their names, so she borrowed books from the library and made notes. Later, Grace joined a science club at school. She shared her drawings of the night sky with other children.
She hopes to become a scientist one day and learn more about space.

groups.part: Part 6 · Find Answers in the Article (33~36)

questions.q: Chloe goes to the library every ______ afternoon.
The library is next to a large ______.
Chloe usually chooses books about ______.
Before going home, Chloe borrows ______ books.

groups.passage:
A Visit to the Library

Every Wednesday afternoon, Chloe goes to the town library with her older brother. The library is next to a large playground. Chloe usually chooses books about animals, while her brother enjoys books about science.
They sit at a table near the window and read quietly for an hour. Before going home, Chloe borrows two books. On the way back, they sometimes stop at a bakery to buy bread for their family.

questions.q: Where did Oliver and his classmates start their garden?

choices.A: In front of the school library

questions.q: What was Oliver's job in the garden?
Why did some students feel disappointed at first?

choices.A: The plants did not seem to grow.
choices.B: They did not have enough seeds.
choices.C: Their teacher asked them to stop working.

questions.q: What happened after two weeks?

choices.A: The students picked all the vegetables.
choices.B: Small green leaves began to appear.
choices.C: The students started a new garden.

questions.q: Which sentence is TRUE according to the passage?

choices.A: Lucy watered the plants every morning.
choices.B: The students sold their vegetables at a market.
choices.C: The students decided to share their vegetables with the school cafeteria.

groups.passage:
Last month, Oliver and his classmates started a small garden behind their school. Their teacher, Mrs. Brown, gave each student a different job. Oliver was responsible for watering the plants, while his friend Lucy helped plant the seeds.
Every morning, the students checked the garden before their lessons began. At first, nothing seemed to grow, and some students felt disappointed. However, Mrs. Brown told them to be patient. After two weeks, small green leaves began to appear.
By the end of the month, the students had grown several vegetables, including carrots and tomatoes. They were proud of their hard work and decided to share the vegetables with the school cafeteria.

groups.note: 상자에서 알맞은 단어를 골라 쓰세요. 한 단어는 한 번만 써요.
groups.passage:
A Day at the Science Museum

Last Saturday, Daniel and his family visited a science museum in the city. The museum was full of (42) ______ things to see and learn.
When they arrived, Daniel saw a large model of a spaceship near the entrance. His younger sister was surprised because it looked so real. Daniel's father (43) ______ a map of the museum from the information desk to help them find different exhibitions.
First, they visited a room about space. Daniel learned about planets and stars. He also took many (44) ______ with his camera to show his friends at school.
At lunchtime, the family went to a small café inside the museum. Daniel's mother bought sandwiches and juice for everyone. After eating, they watched a short science show.
Before leaving, Daniel (45) ______ a video about how robots work. He enjoyed learning new things and hoped to visit the museum again soon.
